knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the relationship is decided by how the work is actually done, not by a label or an ABN alone. An ABN (option 0) and uniform colour (option 2) are not the test.

The lesson says that where the relationship is unclear, the business seeks advice from the regulator or a qualified adviser before work starts, and records the decision. Starting and deciding later (option 0) and asking the person to decide (option 2) are not appropriate.
The why the relationship matters section says the label on the contract does not decide the relationship alone, and that how the work is actually done matters.

practicalCriteria: Learner describes how a supplied job will be done (hours, methods, equipment, who bears the risk) and states the relationship that follows.
Learner records the relationship decision and the reason, with the insurance and licence copies on file with expiry dates, before the work starts.
Learner identifies from a supplied case that the relationship is unclear and names the adviser or regulator to consult before work starts.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Engagement record with relationship decision, reason and check date
Insurance certificate and licence copies with expiry dates
stopWorkCriteria: Learner engages a person with no insurance check before the work starts
